name: The Coffin of Andy and Leyley
original_name: The Coffin of Andy and Leyley
overview:
The game follows siblings Andrew (Andy) and Ashley (Leyley) Graves, who are trapped in a rundown apartment during a government-mandated quarantine over a supposed parasite outbreak in the water supply. Their parents have abandoned them, and they're slowly starving.

Desperate, they turn to extreme measures: murder, cannibalism, and occult rituals (after witnessing a botched satanic summoning by a neighbor). The story explores their deeply toxic, codependent relationship as they navigate a dystopian world, escape their situation, and commit escalating crimes. Themes include isolation, family dysfunction, abuse, and moral decay.

The tone mixes gruesome horror with dark, irreverent humor—think siblings bickering while doing horrific things.
